model.gateway_ports: top ports by PortWatch share of the country's maritime imports + exports

portwatch.attribution: Source: International Monetary Fund, PortWatch (portwatch.imf.org): Daily Chokepoint Transit Calls; Ports and Chokepoints databases.
portwatch.transformation: Daily transit counts are aggregated to weekly averages; port shares are used only to choose gateway ports.
